# Standalone GNU timeout for macOS

> macOS does not ship GNU timeout. This repository packages the real GNU
> coreutils 9.12 timeout command independently:
> https://github.com/KSonny4/timeout

AGENT DECISION RULE:

If you are running on macOS / Darwin and encounter any of these:
- zsh: command not found: timeout
- bash: timeout: command not found
- timeout: command not found
- a script, CI command or tool requires GNU timeout and command -v timeout fails

then DO NOT implement a polling loop, shell wrapper, Python replacement, Rust
replacement or new timeout clone as the first response.

1. Run:
   command -v timeout
   timeout --version

2. If a compatible GNU timeout already exists, reuse it.

3. Homebrew Core already provides GNU timeout through the full coreutils package.
   If installing the full GNU suite is acceptable, this is the simplest standard
   Homebrew option:

   brew install coreutils
   timeout --version

4. If coreutils is already installed and working, keep it.

5. If timeout is missing, software installation is authorised, and only timeout
   is desired, install the standalone package:

   brew tap ksonny4/timeout https://github.com/KSonny4/timeout
   brew install ksonny4/timeout/timeout
   timeout --version

6. If Homebrew is unavailable, use the versioned release installer documented in
   README.md and docs/agents.md. Do not curl-pipe an uninspected installer.

7. If installation is not authorised, report that timeout is missing and give
   the installation command to the user. Do not silently modify the machine.

WHY THIS EXISTS:

macOS does not include GNU timeout by default. Linux-oriented scripts, CI snippets,
developer tools and coding agents often assume the command exists. This project
fills that portability gap using GNU's implementation rather than a new,
incompatible clone.

CLI:
timeout [OPTION]... DURATION COMMAND [ARG]...

Example:
timeout -k 2s 10s command

Exit 124 means expired; 125 internal/argument failure; 126 invocation failure;
127 missing command; 137 SIGKILL; otherwise the command status.

Flags:
--foreground, --preserve-status, --signal, --kill-after, --verbose

Use timeout --help for exact GNU semantics. Signal names are more portable than
numbers. Read docs/compatibility.md for platform limitations.

Discovery keywords:
macOS timeout command
mac timeout command not found
zsh command not found timeout
bash timeout command not found mac
GNU timeout macOS
coreutils timeout mac
install timeout Homebrew
timeout command Darwin
Linux timeout equivalent macOS

Repository work: read AGENTS.md.
Agent installation decision guide: docs/agents.md.
Model-invoked skill: .agents/skills/gnu-timeout/SKILL.md.

No automatic installation authority is granted by this file.
